specials.name: Charge Weapon
specials.description: Rev your weapon and fill it with focus, increasing its Charge, to a maximum of level 3. When you hit with a weapon that can consume Weapon Charges, the damage you deal with that attack will increase by 50% per level. (Weapon Charges will expire after 5 rounds.)

specials.name: Weapon Charge Consumption
specials.description: Consumes Weapon Charge, dealing 50% more damage per Charge Level.

specials.name: Elite Engine
specials.description: Charge Weapon FP cost is increased to 8 FP. Attacks do not use up all of your charges, instead the LV is reduced by 1, and the damage bonus is 35% (does not increase with charge amount like normal Excel attacks).

description: The Excel line of weapons were developed in Chaturanga, where the ability to be defensive while increasing offensive capabilities was highly valued. By charging up the weapon, it can explosively spend the focus energy when it strikes an enemy, greatly increasing damage. However, the engine module makes it heavier than other weapons.

specials.description: Casting Astral Belt or refining a natural resource applies or powers up Astral Vector LV 5 (max 100) for 3 rounds. (Astral Vector causes this weapon's basic attacks to deal LV% of your Earth ATK as Earth magic bonus damage. In addition, damage from Astral Belt is increased by half of its LV.)

specials.name: Attract Objects
specials.description: If you have Magnetized the target, inflicts Attract Objects LV2 until your next turn on the target.

specials.name: Vector Lash
specials.description: Triggers before an enemy is attacked. Activate Stone Vector's Astral Vector gaining effect (LV15 instead of 5). If the attack hits, unearth 2 Rocks, and if the user can gain Geomaterial, they gain 2.

description: A magic whip using the power of magnetism to draw in loose rocks. Kicking some up will make the whip more and more powerful.

specials.name: Betrayal Bonus
specials.description: Damaging a unit in the same party as you with this weapon activates the following effect; +10 Upgrade Level to all of Betrayer's Wit's stats for 3 rounds, and restores FP equal to 10% of damage dealt.

specials.name: No One's Friend
specials.description: Inflicts yourself with Confusion for 3 rounds.

description: One should look beyond the cover, lest dangerous words and sharp pages sit close upon your shelf.

name: Jade Insect Whistle

specials.name: Lightning ATK Bonus
specials.description: +5 Lightning ATK.

specials.name: Insect Song Effects
specials.description: When played (via a Song skill): All enemy Insects affected by the song may be inflicted with Confusion for 2 rounds. All allied Insects affected by the song gain Encourage LV3 for 3 rounds, boosting their stats.

specials.name: Insect Summon
specials.description: When played (via a Song skill): If in a battle against monsters, if this is the first time the flute has been played this battle, summons a random Insect monster ally with a level identical to your own to a random battlefield tile.

description: A whistle made out of jade, whose tones seem to attract and distract all manners of multi-legged creepy crawlies.

name: Mugendai

specials.name: Neverending Story Set
specials.description: Set: Neverending Story. 2+ - 1) +3 WIL. 2) +3 CEL. 3) +15% Sound Resistance.

description: A combat fan used in a certain famous singer's dance.

name: Rose Whip

specials.name: Nature Spell Power
specials.description: +10% Power to Nature Spells (Halved if not main weapon.)

specials.name: Charm on Critical
specials.description: Level 15 Charm for 2 Rounds.

specials.name: Rose Flourish
specials.description: Triggers before an enemy is attacked, and replaces the attack. Deals three hits of Slash, Earth and Pierce respectively to the enemy, dealing a total of 110% of Rose Whip's Scaled Weapon Attack. This damage gains a +10 to Hit, and can also critically hit (if it does, applies on critical effects for Rose Whip).

specials.name: Coral Material
specials.description: Material: Coral.

specials.name: Hunted
specials.description: Inflicts Hunted LV14 for 3 rounds if the target is a seafaring monster.

description: This tome was born from the sea, and as anyone who lives there knows, anything that lives in the sea is out to get everything else... that lives in the sea.

name: Baihurai

specials.name: Knockback
specials.description: Knockback 1 tile.

specials.name: Nature and Isespia Spell Power
specials.description: +10% Power to Nature and Isespia Spells (halved if off-hand).

specials.description: Replaces your Light ATK with the target's for 2 rounds.

specials.name: Spotlight
specials.description: Requires Substitute Light ATK to be active. Consumes the status by the weapon and creates Light Shafts in a 2 Size Diamond within 5 Range (LV = Farren's Upgrade Level (UL), 3 rounds).

description: A book containing the autobiography of a mage turned priest.

specials.description: Always enchanted with Divine Weapon (+2 Power, +5 Critical, +5 Accuracy, -2 Weight. Weapon durability cannot decrease.)

name: Dynamic Tome

specials.name: Custom Spell
specials.description: Grants access to a custom spell in battle. The spell will deal magic damage to units it targets equal to the scaling of this weapon, plus 100% of your Elem ATK of the same element. By installing Spell Seeds into this tome's customization slots, their effects will also be applied, generally to the targets of the spell. This special tome can be modified with Spell Seeds to give its spell additional effects. You can right-click this item and select 'set-style-mode' to change the effect of style seeds to display on enemies, yourself, or the location(s) you target.

description: This special tome can be modified with Spell Seeds to give its spell additional effects.

name: Forgrint

specials.name: Transform to Spear
specials.description: Grants a skill that can change this weapon into a Spear (or back into a Tome).

specials.name: Fallenharn
specials.description: Shoots a spirit spear into the air, causing it to land at a target location within 5 Range. At the end of the round, the spear will release accumulated energy, dealing X Blunt magic damage (X = Scaled Weapon Power + 50% of Light ATK) to all enemies in a 4 Range circle around it. It may also Blind damaged enemies for 2 rounds (more effective VS monsters). It may also stun Spatial enemies.

description: A type of artificer tome that creates magical spears. It can even change into one itself.

name: Grandovyn

specials.name: Transform to Sword
specials.description: Grants a skill that can change this weapon into a Sword (or back into a Tome).

specials.name: Swordsmith Rain
specials.description: Creates a rain of swords at a 3 Range circle up to 3 Range away, dealing X Pierce magic damage (X = Scaled Weapon Power + 50% of Lightning ATK) to all enemies inside of it. It may also inflict Lingering Damage (Pierce) LV X (X = 8 + Upgrade Level of Grandovyn) for 3 rounds (more effective VS monsters). It may also stun Jammer enemies.

description: A type of artificer tome that creates magical swords. It can even change into one itself.

name: Morimayer

specials.name: Random Spirit Attack
specials.description: This weapon's attack skill uses one of 4 random spirits; each will provide a different bonus and damage type for the attack. If the attack hits, you also gain a status effect based on the animal, which increases either your Scaled Weapon Attack, Hit, Critical, or Armor by a small amount, and provides a single-use cast of a random spell. (Shark of Morimayer: Water damage, +10 SWA to the initial attack, +3 SWA buff, Wild Waterfall.) (Tiger of Morimayer: Lightning damage, +10 Critical to the initial attack, +3 Critical buff, Ritual Levin) (Rock Eater of Morimayer: Earth damage, +10 Critical Damage to the initial attack, +3 Armor buff, Geo of Crumbling) (Crow of Morimayer: Wind damage, +10 Hit to the initial attack, +3 Hit buff, Star Stream)

description: A summoning scroll holding a small host of minor spirits. Its power is unpredictable, yet formidable.

name: Rexys

specials.name: Transform to Axe
specials.description: Grants a skill that can change this weapon into an Axe (or back into a Tome).

specials.name: Spirit Trip
specials.description: Creates a spirit axe that travels in a line, dealing X Slash magic damage (X = Scaled Weapon Power of Rexys + 50% of Fire ATK) to all enemies in it. It also has a chance to inflict Burn LV X (X = 8 + UL) for 3 rounds (more effective VS monsters). In addition, any Possessed or Ghost monsters hit by it may be stunned.

description: A type of artificer tome that creates magical rods. It can even change into one itself.

name: Screaming Tome

specials.name: Screamer
specials.description: Have the Screaming Tome bite your hand, causing you to take 10% (20% if not your main hand weapon) of your maximum HP as unresistable Piercing damage. In exchange, the magical bite will remove any Silence you are suffering (ignoring any effects that would prevent its curing), letting you yelp in pain.

description: This tome seems to be rather... occult in nature, given that the skull on it seems to move around a bit. You might want to watch your fingers. Also, it makes a dreadful noise.

name: Aquaphobia

specials.name: Water ATK Bonus
specials.description: Increases Water ATK by UL/2. (Doesn't stack.)

specials.name: Fear Infliction
specials.description: 100% Chance to Inflict Fear for 3 turns.

specials.name: Frozen Fear
specials.description: Creates (or moves, if already active) a Frozen Fear at target location within 5 Range. While active, the Frozen Fear becomes the center point for Aquarian spells you cast (excluding movement skills). You can use this skill on your current location to destroy your Frozen Fear. (Destroying it will restore 2 Momentum.)

description: The fear of water is quite logical. Many of its victims would agree.

name: Balrog

specials.name: Fire ATK Bonus
specials.description: Increases Fire ATK by UL/2. (Doesn't stack.)

specials.name: Lingering Fire Damage
specials.description: Inflict Lingering Damage (Fire) LV UL for 2 rounds.

specials.name: Fire Warrior Summon
specials.description: On Defeat Enemy: If the enemy wasn't Illusion race, summons a smoldering copy of it as a Fire Warrior. Fire Warriors do not retain the special abilities of the copied unit, but their Fire damage ignores immunities and similar effects. (Doesn't stack.)

description: Said to be the whip of a volcanic, demon-like entity. Its cruel lash becomes a collar that burns its victims until the very last ash is cured.

name: Carteblanche

specials.name: Airborne Range Bonus
specials.description: While Airborne, basic attack and sub-attack range is increased by UL/6.

specials.name: Ice Sheet Airborne
specials.description: Stepping on Ice Sheets doesn't trigger them and instead makes you Airborne. Airborne is sustained as if you had Flight while over Ice Sheets.

specials.name: Circle Attack
specials.description: Attacks in a Circle (2) area.

description: A snowstorm in two-hundred pages.

name: Coastal Squall

specials.name: Aquarian Spell Power
specials.description: +UL% Power to Aquarian Spells (Halved if not main weapon.)

specials.name: Sylphid Spell Power
specials.description: +UL% Power to Sylphid Spells (Halved if not main weapon.)

specials.name: Hurricane Summon
specials.description: After Cast Spell: If a Sylphid or Aquarian spell, if you have casted both a Sylphid and Aquarian spell this round, +UL% chance to summon a Hurricane LV UL for 4 rounds.

description: This magical fan's dance will inspire nature itself to get up and shake it... just be careful you don't get lost in the resulting hurricane.

name: Desert Wind

specials.name: Isesipian and Sylphid Spell Power
specials.description: +UL% Power to Isesipian and Sylphid Spells (halved if off-hand).

specials.name: Sandstorm Creation
specials.description: UL% chance after casting a Isesipian and Sylphid spell in the same round to create a sandstorm, dealing UL unresistable Earth Damage to all enemies for 4 Rounds.

description: This magical fan's dance will inspire nature itself to get up and shake it... just be careful you don't get lost in the resulting sandstorm.

name: Manic Slasher

specials.name: Range Increase
specials.description: Attack range increases by UL/6.

specials.name: Lingering Damage on Critical
specials.description: UL Lingering Damage for 3 Rounds.

description: A whip that lashes with manic fury.

name: Torment Noctis

specials.name: Status Infliction Bonus
specials.description: Increases status infliction rate by UL/2%.

specials.name: Black Spirit Consumption
specials.description: When using a Curse skill; if you are possessed by Black Spirit(s), one of them will be consumed at random to boost the LV and duration of the Curse status by 50%.

description: A paintbrush used to draw circles and other symbols for rituals, specifically made to help channel souls into arcane rituals and curses in a unique way.

name: Vorso Verso

specials.name: Youkai Contract Bonus
specials.description: Increases Youkai contract maximum by 1 per 12 UL.

specials.name: Tactician's Order Boost
specials.description: Increases the LV of Tactician's Order skills by UL%.

specials.name: Party Spell Power
specials.description: Spell power increased by 1 per party member (including associates) up to a maximum of UL/3.

description: This nefarious tome contains many texts on how to motivate and manipulate large amounts of people. Could be used for good or ill...
